summary: This 6-K filing of J & Friends Holdings Ltd (a foreign private issuer) attaches the form of indenture for potential future debt securities under its previously filed F-3 shelf registration. The filing is purely administrative—no specific offering, terms, or amounts are disclosed. It incorporates a boilerplate indenture template and reports the filing of the F-3. There is no M&A, activist, spin-off, or other special-situation event. The document is analogous to a US domestic registrant’s 8-K announcing a shelf filing, which is routine. Therefore, no special-situation category applies.
